successCriteria.note: Two app-hosted real OMP chats discovered stable peer ids, exchanged a message and correlated reply via native tools, including a stopped recipient read after restart (DM-505-app-run/result.json).
Mail and acks survived app/terminal restart and DB reopen/restore; sender-scoped retries deduped; human seen never consumed agent mail (DM-505-cli-results.json, app run).
Terminal status/notice and desktop counts recovered after restart; hostile peer text only in tool results; passive notices made no model request or steering (app run c5).
Allow one wake consumed once before one fixed follow-up; no rearm from traffic/restart/duplicate click; failed dispatch shows attempted, no refund (app run c5/c6).
Core services enforce bound grant, folder/machine scope and current revocation; spoofed/unbound/stdio/foreign requests refused with positive controls and no body leakage (DM-505-cli-results.json).
Built, portable and installed (scratch-appId variant, person-approved) Windows builds load the bundled extension; DoD and real journeys recorded; macOS/Linux unit-tested only.

outcome.summary: Native same-folder Skitarii messaging shipped and was proven on Windows with real OMP chats, real models, the built CLI and packaged builds; macOS/Linux unit-tested only.

title: Skitarii communications: durable direct messages, replies and safe agent notifications
